caption: The drawing depicts a single, large earthenware jug placed centrally on a plain background. The jug has a rounded, slightly tapered body that widens at the middle and narrows towards the base and the neck. It features a single curved handle attached from just below the rim to the upper shoulder of the jug. The color of the jug is predominantly brown with mottled patterns, showing variations of darker and lighter shades, and some reddish-brown patches, primarily towards the lower right side. The top rim is slightly flared, and the jug mouth is open, with a visible oval shape. There is a white highlight along the front center of the jug, indicating reflected light. The background is an off-white or light beige color, and a thin, faint rectangular border frames the area around the jug. There is a signature, "Annie B. Johnston," written in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
